outcome: time to attainment of full enteral feeds (FEF)
cohort: The study included consecutive preterm fetal growth restricted (FGR) neonates delivered at 28-36 weeks gestation and admitted to a level III NICU.
finding: Preterm FGR neonates with absent/reversed end-diastolic flow (AREDF) have a significantly longer time to attain full enteral feeds, more feed intolerance, higher mortality, and prolonged hospital and NICU stays compared to those without AREDF.
